featured_reviews.name: Tasmiya Bano
featured_reviews.review_text: Given the short duration for IELTS preparation, I thoroughly enjoyed and learnt a gamut of words and phrases from Arpana. I didn't make it to her elite league, but have gained proficiency nevertheless.

featured_reviews.name: Kurban Ali
featured_reviews.review_text: Despite the virtual distance present in online learning, I never felt lost in Arpana's classes. Unlike most trainings, where it is usually a one-way communication, her classes are a two-way exchange. In fact, many times I felt I am speaking to a senior friend. Her accent classes were a game changer for me and so were other aspects of language training. Be it English or Sanskrit, Arpana is a dedicated teacher.

featured_reviews.name: Ashad Ali
